purpose: Zoom the current view by the declared wheel-step count and direction over the viewport.
trigger: Use when the cursor is over the viewport and wheel direction/step behavior is calibrated in the session.

inputs.name: viewport
inputs.description: Maximized viewport and one cursor position over the model/empty viewport.

inputs.name: wheel_steps
inputs.description: One finite signed number of wheel steps and intended zoom direction.

inputs.name: navigation_mapping
inputs.description: Calibrated wheel-to-zoom direction and step behavior for the current navigation theme.

preconditions: The cursor is over the viewport and wheel behavior has been calibrated in the current session.
wheel_steps is finite, nonzero, and its sign/direction is explicit.

outputs.name: zoomed_view
outputs.description: Before/after apparent scale, cursor position, applied wheel steps, and geometry-unchanged observation.

postconditions: One wheel action changes apparent scale in the expected direction while model geometry, orientation, and selection remain unchanged.
A reversed or unobservable wheel effect is reported as a mismatch, not silently normalized.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the window maximized/full-screen unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI observation/action; it must calibrate the current mapping and must not expand this atom into a view workflow. Wheel direction is navigation-theme dependent and must be observed in the current session.
